<function name="IsSky" parent="SurfaceInfo" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Checks if the brush surface is displaying the skybox.

<note>This internally checks the SURFDRAW_SKY flag.</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Returns true if the surface is the sky.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
